stem: In the equation \((kx + 7)(4x - 3) = 12x^{2} + bx - 21\), \(k\) and \(b\) are constants, and the equation is true for all values of \(x\). What is the value of \(b\)?
verify:
x, k = symbols('x k')
ks = solve(Eq(Poly(expand((k*x + 7)*(4*x - 3)), x).coeff_monomial(x**2), 12), k)
assert ks == [3]
b = Poly(expand((3*x + 7)*(4*x - 3)), x).coeff_monomial(x)
assert b == 19
assert [Rational(s) for s in spr_answers] == [19]
